ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

3. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.

4. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

5. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

6. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

7. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

8. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word

9. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.

10. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

11. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

13. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

14. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. blue
   C. quickly
   D. happiness

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
